description: Report what a story the team estimated cost once delivered: files touched, lines added and removed, tests added, working time. Numbers only. Returns the list with each measure and the card it looks like; refused for a story with no kept estimate, and when the host locked the room.

minutes.description: working time in minutes, when known

story.description: the position of the story in get_estimates, from 1

name: report_actual

markdown.description: the same list as a Markdown table

actual.description: what the story cost once delivered, when someone reported it

minutes.description: working time in minutes, 0 when unknown

estimate.description: the card the team kept, empty when none yet

looksLike.description: the card this measure is closest to among the other measured stories, empty while there are too few

onTable.description: true for the story being estimated now
